title: The AI Native Dev Trailer
description:
Welcome to the AI Native Dev Podcast, hosted by Guy Podjarny and Simon Maple. If you're a developer or dev leader, join us as we explore and help shape the future of software development in the AI era. Dive into exciting AI-powered dev tools and hear from their makers on how they work and how you should use them. We'll discuss the evolving role of software developers and what AI native software development looks like. Tune in every Tuesday for insights from industry trailblazers, and every other Thursday for expert deep dives. Don’t miss our monthly roundups with Guy and Simon, filled with learnings and a touch of banter. Subscribe now to supercharge your development and be part of the next generation of software development.
